text: この　さきの　シオン　タウンに　ポケモンの　なまえを　うらなって　くれる　ひとが　いるよ　ポケモンに　もっと　いい　なまえを　つけ　なおす　ことも　できるよ
note: The Japanese says the man tells fortunes from names, which refers to seimei handan, a Japanese practice of judging whether a name is lucky, traditionally from the stroke counts of its characters. The English game turned him into someone who simply "rates" nicknames.
claim: Seimei handan (姓名判断) is a Japanese form of fortune-telling that judges a name's luck from the number of strokes in its characters.
